approach: Human-style browser inspection of publicly accessible district-operated resident school finders. These are source functionality checks, NOT claims that all home addresses have independently verified school assignments or current GIS polygons.
residentLookupCompletionCriterion: Live official Finder must show a single elementary, middle and high/freshman school path for an actual entered location; mere link availability or an unfiltered school catalog is insufficient.

districts.inputInstructions: Search street name only; select the address-number range matching the home number.
districts.notes: Exact source row re-read after a first automation pass inaccurately generalized range as 2000–2099. The literal official cell is '2050'.

districts.observedBehavior: Address entry and Find on Map did not produce a uniquely identified zoned elementary/middle/high set. The many school cards remained indistinguishable from the default unfiltered directory in tested sessions.
districts.conclusion: Do not mark the address-level lookup as verified. These browser observations do not establish that the locator is universally broken for every resident browser and address; request confirmation through CFB Student Services.
districts.feederPathStatus: 21 official 2026–27 elementary-to-middle/high paths; 20 cross-official-source consistent, 1 contradictory Farmers Branch Elementary; feeder path does NOT assign residence.
